recentItems.title: Meloni’s New Law Targets Violent Protesters In Italy, Says, ‘Parents To Pay, Teens Face Jail’
recentItems.description:
Italian Prime Minister Giorgia Meloni’s government has approved tougher penalties for violent protesters following unrest in Milan and other cities, where more than 100 police officers were reportedly injured. The new security decree introduces prison sentences for violent participation in demonstrations, potential financial liability for parents whose children damage property, and expanded police powers concerning minors. Italy also plans to deploy 500 additional soldiers in Milan.

Meanwhile, France has tightened security ahead of further demonstrations, while protests in Portugal and Spain have highlighted growing concerns over housing affordability, inflation and pressure on public services. European governments face mounting pressure to maintain public order while addressing the economic grievances driving public discontent.

recentItems.title: France Protests: 3,000+ Cops, Curfews In Place Ahead of Oct 24 Unrest! Macron Beefs Up Security
recentItems.description:
France is bracing for fresh demonstrations on October 24 as authorities prepare heightened security measures, including the deployment of over 3,000 police personnel and curfews. With tensions mounting ahead of the protests, President Emmanuel Macron’s administration faces pressure to maintain public order while addressing demonstrators’ concerns. Union talks and security preparations are in focus as France gets ready for another wave of unrest.

recentItems.title: Israel-Hamas Ceasefire Under Pressure: IDF's Gaza Strike Kills 2, Targets Hamas Official | WATCH
recentItems.description:
Israel says it killed Akram Bassam Shaaban Yassin, a senior Hamas security official, in a strike in Gaza. The pre-dawn attack killed two people, including a man and his wife, according to Shifa Hospital. The strike follows other deadly attacks despite a ceasefire between Israel and Hamas. Gaza’s health ministry reports that more than 1,500 Palestinians have been killed by Israeli strikes since the ceasefire began last year.

recentItems.title: US Navy’s P-8A Poseidon Patrols Black Sea After Drone Attacks On Commercial Ships | Watch
recentItems.description:
A US Navy P-8A Poseidon surveillance aircraft has begun reconnaissance patrols over the Black Sea from Bulgaria’s Varna Airport as NATO increases monitoring following drone attacks on commercial shipping. Bulgarian Navy Commander Rear Admiral Kiril Mihaylov confirmed the aircraft had already conducted missions and would continue operating in the region. Bulgaria has requested additional NATO aircraft and anti-drone systems amid growing concerns over maritime security and shipping safety.
